newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close lower on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close lower on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed lower on Tuesday's settlement day on profit-taking by short-term investors, dealers said.

Profit-taking set off bearish sentiment that pulled the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) index down, dealer Mohammad Ali said. The index is likely to open mixed on buying of speculative stocks on Wednesday's new accounts day.

The Karachi 100-index closed 16.14 points, 1.01 percent, lower at 1,577.23 amid 170 losers and 89 gainers at 14.10 p.m. (0910 GMT). Pakistan Telecommunication Co Ltd fell 0.80 rupee to 30.85. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
